newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hansom denies in capital injection talks.
newsitem.headline: Hansom denies in capital injection talks.

text.p: Construction firm Hansom Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was not in talks regarding a capital injection or acquisitions.
"We confirm that there are no negotiations or agreements relating to intended capital injection, acquistions or realizations with any parties," the company said in a statement.
Hansom said it made the statement in response to local press articles relating to a capital injection by a Chinese party.
Hansom shares rose HK$0.30 to HK$2.60 in early afternoon.
Last week, Hansom said it was in talks to sell a stake in a joint venture company.
